reference: Look! The vendor is lowering the basket into the oil.
sk: Pozri! Predavač práve spúšťa kôš do oleja.
cz: Podívej! Prodavač právě spouští koš do oleje.
acceptable: Look! The {vendor|seller|stallholder} is lowering the basket into the oil{ now| right now|}.
Look! {Now|Right now} the {vendor|seller|stallholder} is lowering the basket into the oil.

mistakes.text: Look! The {vendor|seller} lowers the basket into the oil.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Deje sa to práve teraz, patrí tu Present Continuous: „is lowering“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děje se to právě teď, patří sem Present Continuous: „is lowering“.

mistakes.text: Look! The {vendor|seller} lowering the basket into the oil.
Look! The {vendor|seller} is lowering the basket {in|to} the oil.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri pohybe dovnútra patrí „into“: „into the oil“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Při pohybu dovnitř patří „into“: „into the oil“.

mistakes.text: Look! {Vendor|Seller} is lowering the basket into the oil.
Look! The {vendor|seller} is lowering the basket into oil.
